sentences.chinese: 这次我们去了五个国家。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen qù le wǔ ge guójiā.
sentences.english_hint: We visited five countries on this trip.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 去过 to 去了 for the particular five-country trip.

sentences.chinese: 我们先去了德国，然后去了荷兰。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù le Déguó, ránhòu qù le Hélán.
sentences.english_hint: We went to Germany first, then the Netherlands.
sentences.scenario: Explain the order of your visits.
sentences.source_note: The analysis corrects the learner's account of traveling from Germany to the Netherlands.

sentences.scenario: Tell someone about your travel experience.
sentences.source_note: The analysis contrasts 去过 with 去了; the UK visit is supported by the trip discussion.
The analysis gives this personal drill to practice 住在 instead of the noun 住宅.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí zhè tiáo hé hěn jìn.
sentences.english_hint: My home is close to this river.
sentences.scenario: Point out your home on a map.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我的家很近 by naming the river as the reference point.

sentences.chinese: 我家附近可能会发生水灾。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn kěnéng huì fāshēng shuǐzāi.
sentences.english_hint: There may be flooding near my home.
sentences.scenario: Explain a possible problem near your home.
sentences.source_note: Repeated flood descriptions used 可以 and 有发生; the analysis corrects them to 可能会发生.

sentences.chinese: 在这张地图上看不到这个地方。
sentences.pinyin: Zài zhè zhāng dìtú shàng kàn bu dào zhège dìfang.
sentences.english_hint: You can't see this place on this map.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you cannot point out a place.
sentences.source_note: Adapts the map correction 看不到阿拉木图 using a reusable place reference.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐchuáng yǐhòu, wǒ kàn le xīnwén.
sentences.english_hint: After getting up, I read the news.
sentences.source_note: The analysis supplies this shorter correction for the learner's morning news account.

sentences.chinese: 我在手机上看到了一条新闻。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài shǒujī shàng kàn dào le yì tiáo xīnwén.
sentences.english_hint: I saw a news story on my phone.
sentences.scenario: Say where you saw a news story.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 读我的手机 to reading news 在手机上.

sentences.chinese: 我的朋友吃饭以后生病了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou chīfàn yǐhòu shēngbìng le.
sentences.english_hint: My friend became ill after eating.
sentences.scenario: Explain when your friend became ill.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 以前 to 以后 in the restaurant account without asserting food poisoning.

sentences.pinyin: Xué Zhōngwén de rén yuè lái yuè duō.
sentences.english_hint: More and more people are learning Chinese.
sentences.scenario: Discuss the growing number of Chinese learners.
sentences.source_note: The analysis gives this study-related variation to reinforce 多 for increasing numbers of people.

sentences.chinese: 我不知道这家饭馆好不好。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào zhè jiā fànguǎn hǎo bu hǎo.
sentences.english_hint: I don't know whether this restaurant is good.
sentences.source_note: Repeated uncertainty used 如果 for whether; the analysis provides this restaurant variation.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wèn yí ge wèntí.
sentences.english_hint: I'd like to ask a question.
sentences.scenario: Start a question during Chinese class.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我要一个问题 and recurring attempts to introduce a question.

sentences.scenario: Ask someone about their language skills.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated 不知道说广东话 to 会说广东话 when asking about a learned skill.
